name: iLook
description: Scores user-submitted face photos over REST and MCP, returning face shape, facial symmetry, Golden Ratio phi, and 13 focused appearance measurements as versioned JSON with stable error codes.

skills.name: Score Face
skills.description: Returns an overall 0-100 face score with five named subscores and a confidence value for one submitted adult photo.

skills.name: Analyze Face Shape
skills.description: Identifies the visible face shape from outline cues in a single photo via the analyze_face_shape tool.

skills.name: Analyze Facial Symmetry
skills.description: Measures visible left-right facial balance in the submitted frame via the analyze_facial_symmetry tool.

skills.name: Analyze Golden Ratio
skills.description: Reports an approximate Golden Ratio phi score and proportion context via the analyze_golden_ratio_face tool.

skills.name: Calculate Facial Ratios
skills.description: Computes supported visible facial proportion measurements from one photo via the calculate_facial_ratios tool.

skills.name: Detect Eye Shape
skills.description: Reads visible eye opening and framing, plus eye-corner tilt cues from the companion analyze_canthal_tilt tool.

skills.name: Rate Jawline
skills.description: Describes lower-face definition and taper from a single photo via the rate_jawline tool.

skills.name: Analyze Skin Appearance
skills.description: Reviews visible skin texture and lighting effects in the submitted photo via the analyze_skin_appearance tool.

skills.name: Find Hairstyle Direction
skills.description: Suggests face-shape-aware hair framing and clothing color directions via find_hairstyle_direction and analyze_color_palette.
